parameters.name: AttachmentKey
parameters.description: The key of the attachment that is returned after the attachment is uploaded. You can call the [GetUserUploadFileJob](~~206069~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: PluginParam
parameters.description: The parameters for creating the ticket. The value is a JSON string. The parameters vary based on the ticket type. For more information, see **Supplementary description of PluginParam** below the table.

parameters.name: PluginType
parameters.description: The ticket type. For valid values, see [PluginType parameter description](~~429109~~).

parameters.name: RelatedUserList
parameters.description: The IDs of the stakeholders of the ticket. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description: The tenant ID. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
